## Design

### 2026-10-24 – I began with researching about midi keypad, then I downloaded and uploaded all needed files onto kicad anf followed the guide step by step to make the schematics, then I added the footprints and start

**5.5h**

I began with researching about midi keypad, then I downloaded and uploaded all needed files onto kicad anf followed the guide step by step to make the schematics, then I added the footprints and started the pcb design where i made the footprint for the capacitative buttons in the shape of a paw.Then I arranged the pcb layout and started wiring after making the  edges to be cut and ran the designs check.Then I fixed the errors
